method: translation phase correlation on robust downsampled views
field_rejection_policy: reject whole field if any plane exceeds 20 px, has correlation below 0.20, or worsens correlation by more than 0.02
coverage_policy: at least 90% usable fields in each train/validation split; low-content fields cannot support reliable image-based registration or autofocus
intensity_policy: estimation views normalized; registered data retain global scale

rejection_diagnostic.interpretation: rejections are concentrated in low-content fields
